proof_body:
by
  intro α _ _ h3
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro σ hσ
  rw [Subgroup.mem_center_iff] at hσ
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  ext a
  by_contra hne
  simp only [Equiv.Perm.coe_one, id_eq] at hne
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_notMem_of_card_lt_card (s := ({a, σ a} : Finset α)) (t := Finset.univ) (by
    rw [Finset.card_univ]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.card_le_two) (by omega))
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at hc
  have h := congrArg (fun f : Equiv.Perm α => f a) (hσ (Equiv.swap (σ a) c))
  simp only [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply] at h
  rw [Equiv.swap_apply_left, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (Ne.symm hne) (Ne.symm hc.1)] at h
  exact hc.2 h
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α], 3 ≤ Fintype.card α → Subgroup.center (Equiv.Perm α) = ⊥
